guarantees: The server does not call an AI provider.
Explicit and inferred observations remain distinguishable.
Frequencies are descriptive and never emitted as automatic recommendations.
A parameter choice is not treated as scientifically valid merely because a paper reported it.
Recorded decisions preserve the corpus version and exact evidence snapshot.
Every stored decision is scoped to an authenticated project owner.
Remote submission is blocked until every required executable parameter is bound to a cited investigator decision.
Project-specific guidance filters observations through the versioned pipeline contract and dataset TR.
